_doc: The Wakefin's surfaces (docs/kb/art/creatures/act2/wakefin.md). Slots are the glTF material names; write_materials.py writes assets/creatures/wakefin/materials/<slot>.tres on game/shaders/creature/creature.gdshader. body is the wet lacquer_black body and bill (lifted toward abyss_navy and deep_teal_shadow on the flanks and belly, faint sailfish bars), clearcoat-wet, whose emission mask is the eight spawn_wound wounds along the spine (the weak points, the weak-point pulse); seam is the band along each flank lit in the sea's own light, sea_glow (not glimmer), a slow swell; fin is the dorsal blade (its membrane deep_teal_shadow low down where the sea-glow lights it from below, black rays), the tail lobes, the pectorals and the small fins, with a rim sheen; eye is wet lacquer_black. Colours are palette.json swatches.
